quests.word: BURN A HOLE IN YOUR POCKET
quests.conceptTitle: Idiom Anatomy: BURN A HOLE IN YOUR POCKET
quests.definition: 'Money burns a hole in your pocket' means someone feels an urgent, almost uncontrollable desire to spend money quickly.
quests.example: That bonus is burning a hole in his pocket already.
quests.exampleSentence: That bonus is burning a hole in his pocket already.
quests.contextSentence: That bonus is burning a hole in his pocket already.
quests.origin: A vivid image of money so eager to be spent it seems to literally burn through fabric, an idiom traceable to English since at least the 1500s.
